title: Who Controls the Conversation? User Perspectives on Generative AI (LLM) System Prompts
reasoning: The paper uses Value-Sensitive Design (VSD) as a core framework to investigate how ethical and societal values—such as accountability, freedom from bias, and human autonomy—are encoded in LLM system prompts and perceived by users. It empirical analyzes 'intrinsic values and principles' as a primary category in its taxonomy of prompts.
